decisions.reason: The award is a strong positive signal above aspiration for a close-to-core yogurt line, so management would almost certainly retain it.
As a prominently introduced cheese variant within the firm’s established competence, it would likely be kept while sales information is still limited and the growing market offers some slack.

This semi-hard cheese wheel fits the existing assortment closely, and without clear evidence of performance below aspiration the firm would continue it for further observation rather than reallocate resources immediately.
The spicy cheese extends the core cheese business and, absent a visible shortfall, boundedly rational management would likely tolerate some uncertainty and keep it on the market.
Because this mild creamy soft cheese was presented as rounding out the new offer and stays close to the firm’s core capabilities, it is likely to be retained unless later results disappoint clearly.

Although evidence of success is weak, the washed-rind soft cheese still uses existing resources and know-how, so in a growing industry the firm would probably keep it for another period before considering withdrawal.
